sound_layered_d2_rigid.reflected_energy_measure: 2 x potential energy sum_{r < r_i} p^2 V / (2 K1) over E_0 (equipartition in the travelling reflected wave); output cells
sound_layered_d2_rigid.norm: volume-weighted rel L2 against the reference (output cells)
